name: classify-conflict-is-a-medium-verdict-on-the-ladder
why: M27.4 made `conflict_classification` available, so the only road to `same_meaning` and to any granularity result is open: an agent's judgement, under a proposal, stamped `agent_supplied` with the model and prompt that reached it. The outcome is `same_meaning` deliberately — the typed comparisons (scope, stage, valid time) are deterministic ONLY, because a model confident about arithmetic could resolve a real conflict away. The op stays capability-gated and stays MEDIUM: a verdict the store records as one party's opinion is not one the store claims is true.
